value.intent: Static transparent Ready success icon, cool blue, readable at 1x/3x on #172336; proposed check motif. Full alpha permits fractional alpha; no fixed palette.

intake.rationale: Concrete candidate interpretation for the reviewed scope; source requirements retain their original authority in the selected PLAR and packet.

requirements.name: geometry
requirements.check: Decode a PNG with one static 16x16 frame.

requirements.name: transparency
requirements.check: Background is transparent with no opaque matte; fractional alpha is allowed.

requirements.name: readability
requirements.check: Inspect silhouette readability at 1x and 3x nearest display scale on #172336; assess clear, deliberate pixel-art cluster and edge treatment.

requirements.name: success
requirements.check: Communicates successful completion rather than activity or error/retry.

requirements.name: cool-blue
requirements.check: Uses the cool blue UI accent direction; no exact hex match or fixed palette count required.

requirements.name: sample-check
requirements.check: The proposed completion check silhouette is clear and recognizable.

requirements.name: family-distinction
requirements.check: When family candidates exist, compare at 1x and 3x on actual panel and without color: error/retry is distinguishable, working conveys activity not success, and Paused is distinct from activity, completion and retry. Preserve pending status until those candidates exist.

requirements.name: sample-review
requirements.check: Record representative sample review of silhouette, edges and color treatment before family expansion; bind any approved reference.

requirements.name: consumer
requirements.check: At assets/ready.png verify ok -> succeeded displays the Ready image and label through both statusCell and compactStatus with one 16x16 frame, nearest scale 3 and actual panel alpha compositing. Preserve existing Start and all other allocation IDs.
